_otto.note: analysis.json's twin for the BACK-OFFICE agent — the one that makes the calls (config.js's ELEVENLABS_CALL_AGENT_ID; the dashboard's CALLS tab, ⚙ → TAKE A CALL on the phone). `node loop.mjs configure --file analysis-calls.json` puts it on that agent (the configure button does, with the suite set to calls): what ElevenLabs grades and extracts on every real call Otto makes, and the overrides the phone needs ALLOWED — the first message above all, because a call opens with the row's own line and an agent that declines the override greets a person it rang with 'how can I help you?'. Same shape as analysis.json: one PATCH body for /v1/convai/agents/{agent_id} once `_otto` is stripped. The criteria are generic on purpose — they hold for every call; the per-row expectations live in the tests.
unverified: The same two points as analysis.json: an agent on platform_settings.analysis_items may ignore these legacy fields, and whether a PATCH of platform_settings replaces or merges — the loop reads back and warns, and merges over what the agent has.

criteria.name: Said who he was and why he was calling
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent made this call. Within its first two turns, did it say who it was (Otto, from the delivery office) and what the call was about — the delivery, the stop, the question it had — before asking anything else? Success only if both were said. Failure if the agent opened like a helpline ('how can I help you?') or left the person to guess why they were called.

criteria.name: Confirmed what was agreed and what happens next
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Did the agent end the call by confirming in one line what was agreed with the person — a time somebody will be home, a new delivery day, a stop skipped, that the driver or the customer will be told — and what happens next, consistent with what the person said? A wrong number ended with an apology and nothing disclosed counts as success. Failure if the call ended with thanks alone, with no summary, or with a summary that contradicts the person.

criteria.name: At most three questions
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Count every question the agent put to the person after saying why it was calling; two questions in one turn count as two, and a check that the right person answered ('am I speaking with …?') does not count. Success if the total is three or fewer. Failure if it is four or more.

criteria.name: Did not invent facts
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Did the agent state only things the person said or that were in its briefing (the dynamic variables: the purpose of the call, what the office learned on the call before, the notes on file for the address)? Failure if the agent asserted a time, a name, a reason, an address or a promise the person never gave and the briefing did not carry. Asking about something is fine; asserting it is not.

criteria.name: Stayed in one language
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Was every agent turn in the same language, and was it the language the person used (or, when the debrief_language dynamic variable was set, that language)? A single agent turn in another language is a failure. Proper names and street names in another language do not count against it.

criteria.name: Closed by letting the person go
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Did the agent end the call itself with a short thanks and goodbye once what it needed was agreed, rather than trailing off, probing further, or leaving the person to end the call? Success only if the agent's last turn is a clear, polite close.

call_outcome.description: What was agreed on this call, in one or two sentences the office could act on: when somebody is home, a new delivery day and time, a stop skipped, who is told next. Empty if nothing was agreed.

reached_right_person.description: Whether the person who answered was the customer or the driver the agent meant to reach: yes; no (a wrong number, somebody else); or unclear.

somebody_home.description: For a home check: whether somebody will be home in the delivery window (yes), not at all today (no), or only from a later time (later); not_asked when the call was not about that.

question_count.description: How many questions the agent put to the person after saying why it was calling; two questions in one turn count as two.

callee_language.description: The language the person spoke in, as a lowercase ISO 639-1 code such as en or it.
